reviews.comment: Listen. I was terrified going into this class. I had a D- in BICH 410. She was fantastic. It's hard but if you go to SIs (who were great) and office hours, you will be fine. If I can do it, anyone can. My grade went UP with her, and might have been a B if health issues didn't make me delay my final, which she was also very understanding about.

The professor gives hardly any extra credit.However, even including the small amountextra credit points that went toward our exams scores, the average was still below failing and she refused to curve whatsover. Her test's are extremely hard and she writes questions that purposefully mislead you. She also constantly cancels office hours.

Her teaching style is not for me but I don't see the hate. I received a beating but because I could only dedicate one day per exam. Her questions are very simple, low level of thinking. It's tones of material, but 90% of her questions can be answered by studying her slides. OCHEM questions required much more IQ, so just be as diligent as you can.

Despite how she would always ask for feedback regarding why her latest test grade average was a C she would refuse to accept the fact she and her lectures are the problem. Tests are physically impossible to complete, they are mechanism heavy and she even admitted that she doesnt expect us to finish her tests; that we should have to pick and choose
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Do NOT take her!! I took her because she was the only prof offered this semester. If this is the case wait until next semester!! The test averages were always failing (in the 50s). There are 3 tests, the final, 3 homeworks, and 5 quiz grades. Take any other professor, even if it means going in at 8am 5 days a week! she really is that bad!

I took her for both BICH 410 and BICH 411 and class was setup the same for both. She leads discussion based lectures so I stopped going because it does not help. I read the textbook religiously and practiced mechanisms daily in order to get a good grade. She has the word grade distribution in the entire department, for any course. Does not curve!

Idk why everyone is hating, I don't think Pozzi was much better according to my friends. She was always available during office hours and very caring and kind. She just has incredibly high expectations and does not curve. 15 bonus points. I received one A on a test, the rest were low Bs. Did well on the quizzes+ HW and got an A

Just thinking about her makes me mad, hands down the worst prof I've had.  Lectures were all discussion and no lectur, and she never made it clear what we needed to know.  Exam averages were always failing.  She sometimes taught wrong info and refused to accept constructive criticism.  It would be better to graduate late than to take her.

I really enjoyed Dr. Kanchupati. The course was difficult based on the content of BICH 411 but she made things easy to understand and had clear expectations of the course. As someone who isn't great at chemistry, I can guarantee putting in the time and effort to learn the material will improve your grade. Her discussions improved my understanding.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She is the worst professor I have ever had and failed a majority of my section this semester after refusing to help/curve. Thankfully I am not graduating this semester but I know she is the reason some people were not able to. She is extremely rude and cannot comprehend that she is the reason students do poorly on exams. Take literally anyone else
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Everything in this class was pretty tough and the averages for exams were never passing. Most of the extra credit was attendance so go to class! Lectures were fine but were discussion heavy and the exams were on specific details. Got an A in this class due to extra credit, reading the textbook, and watching AK lectures on YouTube. Good luck!

She is single-handedly the reason I am not graduating this semester. She does not curve and has failed so many students this semester. She also violated FERPA during our class by sharing peoples legal names and their exam scores. Her tests are the hardest exams I have ever taken in my life. Averages were typically in the 50/60 range, no curve given

Would recommend staying away from if possible. Lectures were based on PP whose info did not even show up on the exams. Material on exams was based on the small, minor details in the textbook. A lot of reading if you really wanna do well. Like to make sure and make it known that one person made a 100 on tests when the rest of the class failed.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: First off, Biochem is a hard class. However, there is no reason why this class should have been this hard. The tests do not get curved, she will tell you some things will not be on the tests and they will be on there, and the tests are the great majority of the grade. 30-40% of our class Q-dropped. Do not take her.

Take someone else!!! Super test heavy & she doesn't curve even though exam averages were super low. Exam content isn't clear & you can't use your own calculator even though other profs let you. Hardest class I've taken at A&M and I'm 100% sure it would be better to learn from another prof. Very smart but just reads off slides & discussion heavy.

This was THE hardest class I took my entire college career and I barely passed it. Her lectures are not helpful and expected students to know the answers immeditely to continue the discussion. Exam averages were so low that she refused to curve and then yelled at us for scoring so low. If you have the opportunity to take anyone else, do it.

The homeworks and quizzes aren't timed, but I would definitely recommend doing prep work for them otherwise they can take you like two hours. Tests are tough, 30% free response which means mechanisms so get ready to study and memorize them. I did not enjoy her style of lecturing which is very discussion heavy.

BICH 411 is likely the hardest class you'll take in college. The professors can't nearly cover everything you need to know for exams. Be prepared to do most learning on your own. Kanchupati was tough and her exams are quite difficult, especially given the amount of time. You'll have to seriously work for your grade.

I think shes ok, but  the classtime should probably have less discussion, bc it did not seem to work well  (not even 1/2 the class showed up). i probably would do a higher rating but later in the semester too often the slides were confusing and had bad typos. i also believe there were times we were taught inaccurate info (based on other literature)

Her lectures are discussion-based, so she will ask the class many questions and expects us to answer them. She rarely teaches off the slides which made class very confusing to follow along. The exams are by far the most difficult. All the slides, homework, and quizzes will barely help you on the exams. If possible, please take another professor.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Just don't take her. She really should not be teaching. Her classes are discussions not lectures. She does not curve even though test averages are in the 50s/60s. Just save yourself the time and take another prof. You will regret taking this class.

I have been in college for nearly 4 years now and I have never struggled so much in a course like I did in this course. The exams are ridiculous and most people can't even finish in the time we are given. Class averages would be in the 50s. Homeworks and quizzes are hard as well. Class is not helpful. Lecture slides not helpful.

Dr. Kanchupati was just plain ridiculous. Discussion lectures where she would often ask questions nobody knew the answer to and get visibly upset about it. This was far from the worst part of her class: exams. They were flat-out bad. Averages were high 50's-low 60's. Would not change her approach at all and shuts down any constructive criticism.

I dislike her idea of lectures being a "discussion" rather than a lesson. Instead of talking students through difficult concepts, she asks questions before she continues with the lecture and will frequently stand there visibly frustrated waiting for an answer. This is a very challenging course, so be prepared. Tests included free-response and MC.
Dr. Kanchupati is great, exams are fair, take her for 410 or 411 if you can!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Beware of pop quizzes
